dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the lateral flank exhibit irregular, high-frequency edge geometry. The intensity gradient transitions abruptly from the dark-grey exterior to the light-grey interior over a range of 2-4 pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel flecks is localized primarily along the dorsal ridge. These features lack an internal intensity gradient and appear as asymmetrical, isolated clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' shaped annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse triangle. A secondary geometric relationship is defined by a nearly linear alignment of three high-intensity blobs located near the cranial-dorsal interface.
